WHAT: Memory curation has two automatic triggers: PreCompact (context compression) and SessionEnd.

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Context fills up → PreCompact hook fires → curation runs
2. /exit or normal close → SessionEnd hook fires → curation runs
3. Kill terminal / laptop dies → NO hooks fire → session memories lost

RECOVERY: If session was killed, memories can be manually ingested later:
  memory ingest --session <id>

GOTCHA: If you never fill context and never /exit cleanly (e.g., close terminal window), zero curation happens for that session.
